criteria.text: Equal fractional peroxide depletion after split
criteria.evidence: all H2O2 decomposed in first 5 s (O2 0.0005 mol from 0.001 H2O2); post-split H2O2 7.5e-12 / 2.5e-12 mol unchanged over 20 s: no measurable post-split kinetics
substrate exhausted before split; residual 1e-11 mol does not react at all (zero loss both)

first_round.observed_result: Catalase decomposed all 1 mmol H2O2 within 5 s before the split; nothing left to compare.
first_round.limitations: Design exhausts substrate before split; residual peroxide frozen.
first_round.doubts: residual H2O2 1e-11 not reacting during 20 s wait looks like a kinetic cutoff
